communitySetup.aiHearingHelp: Applies to all community members using the updated mod and overlay. Nearby AI can detect players while they transmit. Enabled by default; a mission/server can still disable AI hearing. Changes reach open overlays within 30 seconds.
communitySetup.armaAutomatic: Automatically enabled because your community uses ARMA 3.
communitySetup.armaBridgeHelp: Enable the local ARMA 3 connection for this community. The desktop app automatically starts the installed bridge. Disabling this stops Radio from using the bridge, including signal integration and AI hearing.
communitySetup.armaInstallCaption: Four steps for your server and players
communitySetup.armaSignalHelp: Use radio tower signal quality from the Sonoran Radio ARMA 3 mod running on this computer. Your browser may ask for permission to access the local bridge.
communitySetup.browserNote: A separate desktop overlay cannot reliably appear over exclusive fullscreen. Browser users must enter the mission to let the mod start the bridge and allow local-network access if prompted.
communitySetup.clientMods: In the ARMA Launcher’s Mods tab, enable CBA_A3 first, then Sonoran Radio. Disable older local copies. ACRE and TFAR are not required.
communitySetup.desktopOnlyHint: The overlay requires the Sonoran Radio desktop app. It is not available on the website.
communitySetup.desktopOnlyLabel: Overlay is available in the Sonoran Radio desktop app.
communitySetup.fivemInstallCaption: Download and configure the Sonoran Radio resource
communitySetup.fivemZonesHelp: Configure emergency, geo-channel, and signal degradation zones.
communitySetup.gameHelp: We’ll start you with matching radio frames and screen styling. You can change your game later.
communitySetup.installRequirements: Every player needs ARMA 3 for Windows (2.12+) and both Workshop mods. Subscribe and wait for Steam to finish downloading.
communitySetup.integrationDescription: Choose the game connected to this Radio community.
communitySetup.joinMission: Join your server, select a role, and enter the mission. Equip a Sonoran Radio item. Mission makers should place Sonoran signal towers/repeaters for coverage.
communitySetup.manualServer: For a manually hosted server, copy both mod folders to the server, copy their {extension} files from their keys folders into the server’s {directory} folder, and add this startup argument (adjust folder names):
communitySetup.openDesktop: Open the Sonoran Radio desktop app, join this community, connect to a channel, and click Open Overlay. The installed Workshop bridge starts automatically.
communitySetup.overlayDisplay: In ARMA, choose {displayMode} (borderless) instead of exclusive Fullscreen. In the ARMA Launcher, enable {launcherOption}, then restart the game. This keeps the game running when you click the overlay. The equivalent launch parameter is {parameter}.
communitySetup.resizeInstructions: Ctrl + drag the body, or drag a corner.
communitySetup.resizeOverlayLabel: Drag vertically to resize the radio overlay
communitySetup.restartServer: Restart the server and include both mods in the launcher preset shared with players. Keep signatures and BattlEye enabled; investigate the exact kick message if a client is rejected.
communitySetup.serverMods: Install the same two Workshop mods through your server host’s mod manager. Load both as regular mods, not server-only mods, with CBA_A3 first.
communitySetup.towerSaveError: Unable to save ER:LC signal towers. Your last change was reverted.
communitySetup.unlinkHelp: Live player positions and signal updates will stop until a server is linked again.
communitySetup.verifySignal: Transmit with the desktop app’s push-to-talk. Check that signal bars respond as you move away from a tower. The bridge health page on each player’s PC should show {health}.
communitySetup.zoneSaveError: Unable to save ER:LC zones. Your last change was reverted.

If ER:LC reports exactly one vehicle owned by your account, its name can also select a specific frame. Screen images are not saved or uploaded. On macOS, you may need to allow Screen & System Audio Recording for Sonoran Radio.
